description.description: Why you are reading, in 5-10 words. The user sees it.

containers.description: By exact name. Omit for the default container.

previous.description: The instance before the last restart.

filters.description: Keep only lines from nodes with these names, or region, zone, os or arch labels.

grep.description: A regular expression the message must match.

since.description: Range start: an RFC 3339 time, or an ISO 8601 duration back from now such as PT15M. Omit for the oldest line.

until.description: Range end, in the same forms. Omit for the newest line.

before.description: Context before the range: 0 to 500 lines, or a duration up to P7D.

after.description: Context after the range, in the same forms.

cursor.description: A prev, next or follow token a read printed, copied exactly. Send only page_size, max_message_bytes, max_page_bytes and description with it.
